subject.title: feat: add signed marketplace feed config

question: Is current-head proof enough to accept this staged signed marketplace feed config before signed refresh enforcement lands?
rationale: The code adds a public trust-anchor config surface and intentional fail-closed runtime behavior; automation can identify the stale proof and merge risk, but maintainers own whether that staged contract is acceptable.

options.title: Require Current-Head Proof
options.body: Require terminal or live output at head 756be49f58efd6aae116c09832f3edd549d1cc92 showing signed config validation and the intentional selected-profile no-fetch rejection before merge.

options.title: Merge Only With Enforcement
options.body: Wait to merge this config shape until the signed refresh enforcement work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98338 is ready to land with it.

options.title: Accept Staged Contract
options.body: Allow the staged config surface to merge after proof refresh while owning that selected signed profiles reject until enforcement lands.

recommendation.title: Require Current-Head Proof
